entries.description: Ruled the decision must be made on a measurement, not an estimate, and committed the 1-4 tile bar before any synthesis ran: 'given that every area estimate this project ever made was wrong until synthesized, I wouldn't spend 70 euros on my guess or yours.'

Refused to convert um2 to tiles. The pre-registration flagged the tile constant as not present in this repo and committed to sourcing it or not converting; it was still absent, so the verdict was stated as a RANGE the constant cannot move (3.1-3.5x over) instead of a tile count from memory. A remembered constant would have been an input to a 70-euro decision.

Ran the width sweep rather than reporting a flat no. It converted 'nothing fits' into 'here is the curve and where it would fit', which is the difference between a dead end and a scoped next question. Not asked for; cost five minutes.

Reported timing UNAVAILABLE rather than omitting it or implying it passed. abc emits no delay summary through this flow; two attempts, and the FAILING script is kept in the repo as the artifact behind the claim. House rule 4: a metric that cannot be derived is instrument failure, never zero.

findings.description: SKY130 measured: certified reciprocal (W=32 F=16) is 221,963 um2 of cell area vs a 64-72k um2 four-tile budget — over by 3.1-3.5x. Width sweep shows 4x width costs 11x area, so the kernel-library-to-silicon gap is ~11x and lives entirely in datapath width. Tapeout NOT pre-registered.

A kernel that FITS exists in the parameter space (W=12 at 39k um2), but everything certified is W=32 — the Lean forward-error bounds and @verify contracts are tied to the format, so a narrow variant is a different kernel certified by nothing currently proved. The blocker is certification work, not silicon area.
